test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: After a long moment, she shook her head.
After a long momant, she shock her head.
After a long moment, she shuok her head.
After a long momment, she shook her head.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Moment"** (समय) is the correct spelling and in option 1, it is correctly used.
 
• **"Shook"** (हिला दिया) is the past tense of shake, and it is correctly used in option 1.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 uses **"momant" **instead of "moment" (समय) and **"shock"** instead of "shook".
 
• Option 3 uses "**shuok"** which is not a word in English.
 
• Option 4 uses **"momment"** instead of "moment".
